name: inwards-vscode
description: Architecture rules for Python, live in the editor. Runs `inwards server`, the same code as `inwards check`.

inwards.enable.description: Run Inwards architecture checks on Python files. Turning it off stops the language server.

inwards.path.markdownDescription: The `inwards` executable to start as the language server (`inwards server`). Empty: the binary bundled with this extension, else `inwards` on `PATH`. A bare name is looked up on `PATH`; a relative path resolves against the first workspace folder; `~` and `${workspaceFolder}` are expanded. On Windows it must be an `.exe`. Example: `${workspaceFolder}/.venv/bin/inwards`, to use the version a project pins with `uv add --dev inwards`.

scripts.build: bun build src/client/extension.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming [name].[ext] --target node --format cjs --external vscode

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, Inwards ignores the workspace's `inwards.path`, so a cloned repository can't choose the program it starts.
